name: mirage
text: Status of everything from the last hours. BUILT and shipping in v1.0.26 (release building now): API monitor rebuild (engine checks every API every few minutes; green = up and checked, yellow = slow/some keys refused/a failed check being retried, red = no connection, no credits or every key refused, grey = off; a switched-off API like pinnapi is grey and never called), ParlayAPI Pro key first, ParlayAPI live play-by-play on the engine (default score source with ESPN as the fallback), The Odds API gap-fill cut to every 3 h plus a per-purpose spend log, GitHub-only rule saved for all sessions. MEASURED AND NOT BUILT, with evidence: ESPN CDN scoreboard (cached 101 s, slower), ESPN odds backup (one book only), ParlayAPI arbs for Novig-Kalshi (I scanned 6 sports x 200 arbs plus the live arb feed: ZERO pair Kalshi with anything, so our own Novig-Kalshi comparison stays the source), consensus (same books we already have). NOT DONE YET: live tennis betting and bidding. There was no tennis match live in the 40 minutes I listened, so I have no real tennis frame to build on. The engine now keeps the tennis stream open and records every raw frame to the archive, so the first live match gives me the real shape; I am building the tennis win-probability math now so only the feed wiring is left, and it will run in paper mode before any real tennis order.
